facts.fact: PROXIGAB, an SME platform, was designed and developed by ANINF's own experts, per the Gabonese press agency.
ANINF signed a minute on 2 October 2026 handing the PROXIGAB solution to the SME directorate-general, a platform it built for another government body.
ANINF experts' PROXIGAB platform was officially presented and handed over on 2 October 2026; the date is the presentation, not stated as first go-live.
